payload.text: **Slot desk** (hv, 24 Oct 06:50Z; hv 25 Oct: the ONE host queue for every estate on rhadamanth and kovacs): molt-vc runs heavy/light contention across Molt, Intent, Laksa, Utilz, devbin, Conflab and Gtools. Rules: one heavy, plus one light while the 1-min load is under 60; one cargo run machine-wide, kovacs included; no .app/LS light beside an LS run; START/END by name; first READY first (security wins a tie); a fresh booking after a refused landing or a failed run takes its READY-time place; a node that hands back keeps its original place; every judge runs the critic per changed file and reads its coverage line (not asked, unanswerable or ARMED but NOT RUN covers nothing, never clean; no known-positive samples, hv decision 68 via devbin-vc; Swift's critic arms nothing until Intent 0648); a Swift green needs an executed count above zero; every bats run, single arms included, goes through the desk; a worktree cargo run gets its own CARGO_TARGET_DIR; worktrees in $TMPDIR (hv); message stamps only from a date -u read in an earlier call. The ledger is in the scratchpad, and its last 'QUEUE AT' line holds the order (resumed 16:54Z on hv's 'Resume all' after fold 3).
